newsitem.title: GERMANY: Duesseldorf air passenger halls to open November.
newsitem.headline: Duesseldorf air passenger halls to open November.

text.p: Passengers using Duesseldorf airport will from November 1 no longer have to use tent facilities put up after the April 11 fire, airport authority Flughafen Duesseldorf GmbH (FDG) said on Wednesday.

Two interim halls built for 70 million marks over the last two months will open as Terminal D (west) and Terminal E (east) along with the re-fitted C pier to handle scheduled and charter airlines, an authority statement said.
The tents will be pulled down and the maintenance halls which were also used for passenger handling over the last five months will return to their normal use, FDG said.
Each interim hall covers 10,000 square metres and will have 32 check-in counters, nine gates, a restaurant, duty-free shops and other normal terminal facilities, it added.
